punchline: Five teams, one scorekeeper, and only one method pulled ahead.
thirty_sec: IARPA's tournament gave five teams more than 200 questions, scored by the Brier method. Good Judgment won, beating its own control group by 60 percent and the other teams by 40 percent, and its top 2 percent became superforecasters.
question: Which regular guess of yours could you start writing down this week to check later?
key_contrast: A shared scorecard made the claim testable.
